allowedDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowedDomains.description: Only these domains (and subdomains) are fetched.

maxDepth.title: Link depth
maxDepth.description: How many link hops to follow from each start URL (0 = start URLs only).

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages in total.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: Pages fetched at the same time.

linkKeywords.title: Link keywords
linkKeywords.description: Follow a link only if its URL or text contains one of these.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Plain request timeout (s)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for a plain HTTPS request.

unlockerTimeoutSecs.title: Web Unlocker timeout (s)
unlockerTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for a Bright Data Web Unlocker request (at least 180 s).

maxAttempts.title: Attempts per method
maxAttempts.description: Tries per fetch method before giving up or switching to Web Unlocker.

label.title: Run label
label.description: Free text recorded on every item.
